dct_description_sm: Polygon footprint dataset for NAIP Nevada 2010 1-meter, 4-band image tiles. The ESRI Shapefile contains 7,454 polygon features representing image tile footprints. Source imagery dates recorded in the SrcImgDate attribute range from 2010-05-07 to 2010-11-16. Attributes include tile filename, quadrangle name, state, UTM zone, resolution, band, source image date, and verification date. Coordinates are in NAD83 geographic coordinates.
